snippet.title: ROGOLF - Reveal Trailer (Alpha footage)
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/3810020/ROGOLF

ROGOLF is an upcoming rogue-lite, where you play mini-golf, buy equipment and get points based on your collected coins & remaining shots. You'll have to have enough cumulated points to go through each Gates, and reach the top !

Each game is different and each levels have its own rules ! You'll have to trade your tees for items that will change the course of your run !
